summary:
Iteration 50 — FINAL PRE-PUBLISH smoke test for Guardian Health & Angel. Backend pytest suite: 13/15 PASS (86.7 %). Frontend Playwright smoke: EVERY judge-facing screen renders correctly with all requested testIDs present, DEMO badge visible, tabs (HEALING/FAMILY SHIELD/VAULT) all healthy, 0 red-screens across 10 routes.

*** ONE BLOCKING ISSUE — MUST BE FIXED BEFORE PUBLISH ***
**EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is INVALID.** Both AI-powered judge flows fail: (1) POST /api/agent/chat → 502 Bad Gateway; (2) POST /api/magic-lens → 502 Bad Gateway. Backend logs show:  `AuthenticationError: OpenAIException - Invalid API key`. Current value in /app/backend/.env: `EMERGENT_LLM_KEY=sk-emergent-e89D704DaB3AbF4Ce8`. This directly breaks two of the marquee demos in the review checklist — Jarvis typed chat + Magic Lens vision. Console errors on /jarvis screen also show 502s during morning briefing generation.

All other flows PASS end-to-end:
  • AUTH: Founder dev-bypass (POST /api/auth/dev-bypass) → 200; founder-bypass-btn login lands on home with DEMO badge (data-testid=demo-badge), welcome banner (home-welcome-banner), Jarvis orb (home-orb), Magic Lens tile (home-magic-lens), emergency FAB (fab-emergency-qr), and tabs HEALING/FAMILY SHIELD/VAULT visible.
  • FOUNDER TOOLKIT: /founder-toolkit renders full forecast 2026-2030 (all 5 years present in DOM), English roadmap ('Global launch' visible), English doc descriptions ('Project overview…' visible), gold ft-jury-pdf row present. 0 Slovak diacritic hits on the whole screen.
  • JURY CHEAT-SHEET PDF: GET /api/founder/jury-cheat-sheet returns 200 application/pdf 244 464 bytes (%PDF magic verified) both with Bearer header and with ?token= query; returns 401 without any auth. All three assertions PASS.
  • LIFE CARD: /health-timeline renders with seeded demo data (Guardian Angel · DOB 15.3.1985 · A+ · 41y), category filters ht-filter-all/ht-filter-vaccine present, PDF export GET /api/lifecard/report.pdf → 200 application/pdf (%PDF magic OK). ht-add and lc-pdf testIDs present.
  • FALL FLOW: /fall-verify renders fall-im-ok + fall-help-now; tapping I'M OK — no crash, no red-screen (URL stays because Playwright deep-linked without history stack; in-app navigation stack would resolve). This is an artifact of direct URL load, not a real bug.
  • EMERGENCY: fab-emergency-qr present on home (renders emergency QR screen).
  • TABS: /healing, /family-shield, /vault all render without red-screen; Guardian Eye FAB (home-orb) visible on home.
  • BACKEND CORE SMOKE: /api/ 200, /api/origin 200, /api/lifecard 200, /api/token/wallet 200, /api/founder/toolkit 200, /api/marketplace/offers 200, /api/subscription 200 (founder tier = archangel confirmed).
  • SUBSCRIPTION regression: GET /api/subscription → 200 with founder = archangel tier (as expected).

SMALL FIX APPLIED THIS ITER (English sweep completion): fixed one residual Slovak fragment in the Jarvis morning-briefing offline fallback. /app/backend/routes/agent.py:646 was returning `Vonku je {c} °C, {desc}.` when the LLM call failed → replaced with English `It's {c} °C, {desc}.`. This was visible in the /jarvis screenshot because the LLM 502 forced the fallback path.

MINOR ENDPOINT-NAME DISCREPANCY (not a bug): the review request references /api/compass/offline-pack but the actual route is /api/compass/pack (source: routes/compass.py:121). /api/compass/pack returns 200 with the offline bundle; test was updated to hit the real path.

KNOWN/ACCEPTED (per review context — NOT flagged): preview objstore 401 → file-upload endpoints 502 in preview only; protected Slovak files (mosaic/subscription/arbitrage/barter/billing/i18n); language names on picker; camera/mic sensors headless-limited.

critical.issue: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in /app/backend/.env is INVALID → both AI endpoints return 502. Backend log: `litellm.AuthenticationError: OpenAIException - Invalid API key`. This directly breaks the Jarvis typed-chat and Magic Lens vision judge flows required by the review checklist. Regenerate the Emergent LLM key and update EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in backend/.env, then `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`.

minor.issue: Route does not exist — actual route is /api/compass/pack (routes/compass.py:121). /api/compass/pack returns 200. Either fix the request spec or add an alias in compass.py.
Returns 404 — actual endpoint is /api/subscription (200, founder tier=archangel). Consistent naming would help.

integration_issues.issue: Both AI features fail due to invalid EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (see backend critical). On /jarvis the morning briefing falls back to a static placeholder; typed messages will return an error toast. Magic Lens image analysis returns 502.

action_items: **BLOCKER — rotate EMERGENT_LLM_KEY** in /app/backend/.env and restart backend. Current key `sk-emergent-e89D704DaB3AbF4Ce8` is rejected by Emergent's OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Without this, Jarvis chat + Magic Lens (two headline demos) will fail live in front of the jury.
Optional cleanup: add a /api/compass/offline-pack alias (or rename /pack) so the doc/spec matches, and expose /api/subscription/tier alongside /api/subscription for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: founder.py cheat-sheet endpoint is clean: proper _auth_pdf handles Bearer + ?token=, 401 fires correctly without auth, PDF file exists at /app/release_package/JURY_CHEAT_SHEET.pdf (244 464 B). Forecast + roadmap payloads are fully English and match spec.

seed_data_creation: None. Reused founder session via idempotent /api/auth/dev-bypass. Founder demo Life Card (POST /api/demo/seed) is auto-seeded at startup and visible on /health-timeline.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iter50_final_smoke.py — it covers: dev-bypass login, /api/auth/me (nested {user:{...}} shape), core smoke (/api/, /api/origin, /api/lifecard, /api/token/wallet, /api/founder/toolkit, /api/compass/pack, /api/marketplace/offers), founder toolkit + jury PDF (Bearer + ?token= + 401), lifecard PDF, subscription (founder=archangel), Jarvis chat, Magic Lens vision. After E1 rotates EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, only the Jarvis + Magic Lens tests should flip from FAIL → PASS. The tiny PNG used for Magic Lens is a hex-literal in the test file. Founder token TTL is short — always call dev-bypass fresh at the start of each run. Founder auto-seeded at backend startup so no manual DB inserts required.
rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE — Emergent LLM key invalidation. Backend uses `from core import ... EMERGENT_LLM_KEY` and passes it into `LlmChat(api_key=EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, ...)` at agent.py:143/364/512/636/692/817/978. When the key is rejected the litellm library raises AuthenticationError which routes/agent.py & routes/magic_lens.py catch and re-raise as HTTPException(502) (visible in backend logs as `magic lens error: … Invalid API key` and `agent chat error: … Invalid API key`). Reproduction: `curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer <founder>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"message":"hi"}' https://guardian-vault-13.preview.emergentagent.com/api/agent/chat` → 502 HTML Bad Gateway page in <1 s (would take 5–30 s if the LLM were reachable). Mitigation: (1) rotate the Emergent LLM key in backend/.env, (2) `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`, (3) re-run pytest — Jarvis + Magic Lens will pass.
